competences.description: Performs an unpredictable attack and decreases the target's Attack Power for 1 turn. This attack will also increase the target's chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 1 turn if this attack lands as a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.

The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times with a sandstorm. Each hit decreases their Attack Bar by 30% with a 50% chance.

If an ally receives an attack that kills them, that death will be prevented and 30% of your MAX HP will be transferred to that ally. This skill will not activate if your HP is below 30%. [Automatic Effect]
